messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning to cut release/1.16 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need quick agreement on: backport policy, who creates the branch, and changelog/version bump process. Security + blockers only by default. Any objections?

sam: +1 for security + blockers only. For anything else owners should opt-in via this channel and add label `backport-request`.

lee: I can create the branch if nobody else is lined up. Naming: `release/1.16` ok? or do we want full semver `release/1.16.0`?

maria: `release/1.16` is our convention (we tag with full semver later).

rahul: Quick note on version bump: we'll publish tag `v1.16.0`. Please don't change the version file in backport PRs — do the bump in a separate PR against the release branch. I'll take that PR.

sam: Changelog process: each backport PR must include a one-line changelog entry in the PR body under `Changelog:`. We'll consolidate into the release notes. Format: `component: short description (#PR)`.

lee: OK creating branch now. Command I use:```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.16 origin/main
git push origin release/1.16
```I'll open the branch-create PR and ping here when done.

release-bot: Branch `release/1.16` created by lee at 2469125600 • CI triggered • docs build queued.

nora: Quick QA rules for this cut: smoke test on branch required before merging any backport. If PR touches runtime perf, mark `needs-regression-eval` and attach perf run.

maria: Backport rules recap: security & severity-P0/P1 bugfixes auto-eligible. Anything else needs explicit owner approval. Backport PRs must: 1) target `release/1.16`, 2) include original commit hash and `cherry-pick -x` footnote, 3) include `Changelog:` line, 4) mention the approving component owner.

sam: Example cherry-pick steps for folks who asked:```bash
# from your feature branch
git checkout release/1.16
git pull origin release/1.16
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
# resolve conflicts, commit, push
git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/backport/<issue>-to-1.16
```Add label `backport/release-1.16` to the PR.

lee: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/3245 (branch-create + initial CHANGELOG stub). Leaving the changelog stub — rahul to bump version.

rahul: I'll open the version bump PR against `release/1.16` in ~20m and include release notes draft. Assigning to @sam for final changelog merge.

nora: QA ETA: smoke tests start once CI is green on branch — roughly 2h from now. If anyone has urgent security backports, ping me with the PR link and `priority/urgent`.

maria: Thanks — plan: cut stays at 09:00 PT tomorrow. I'll post a 1h cutoff reminder and a 15m final nudge. If you want a backport considered, open your PR *now* and add the `backport-request` label.

sam: I'll sweep open security PRs and open backport PRs for the ones we include, will post links here. :thumbsup:

lee: branch-create PR is merged, CI green. tag me if you need handoffs on conflict resolves.

maria: Great work. If anything blocks, call out here or DM. I'll collect final backport list 30m before cutoff.
